name: single-ledger-invariant
title: test: 钉住『一次发布只有一个账本 claim』+ 不变量文档收口（票 5by）
description: 新增用例：approved publish 经执行器后，主链 publish_id 账本为 CONFIRMED 且 executor 的 intent_effects 命名空间为空（executor 以 artifact_store=None 构造，不重复 claim）；同时更新 docs/publish-action-protocol.md 的不变量 2 为分支 B 收口后的终态（有 intent 唯一入口、无 intent 回退直调是显式例外、一次发布一个账本 claim），并把迁移期『不做』条目标注为历史。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-01 (test + docs only). The branch-B cutover keeps exactly one effect-ledger claim per publish by constructing the executor with artifact_store=None; that decision lived only in a code comment, and re-adding the executor ledger would create two claims in different namespaces that can disagree after a crash (mainline CONFIRMED vs executor IN_FLIGHT), making a retry's answer depend on which one it reads. Added test_an_approved_publish_touches_only_the_mainline_ledger: it runs an approved publish through the executor with a real InMemoryStore, asserts the mainline publish_id record is CONFIRMED and that store.asearch(('publish','intent_effects')) is empty. Updated docs/publish-action-protocol.md invariants: item 2 now states the end state (execute_action is the only execution entry when an intent exists; the no-intent direct call is an explicit exception pinned by mainline_direct_publish_invocations=1; one ledger claim per publish, pinned by this test), and the migration-era 'not doing' bullets are marked historical. Verification: the new test passes standalone (12.06s); docs/claims gates run inside the full suite; full suite in the journal; ruff green.
